summary: PromptBox must stay reachable while a mask tool is active. Raised by the user right after verifying MPI-371: masking and adjusting generation settings are mutually exclusive modes because prompt is a rail tool, so every tweak costs a round trip. The mask family makes it repeat per tool. Design job, not a CSS job - prompt mode swaps the viewer surface via swapToPreview / swapToCanvas, and resolving that coupling IS the task. Three options in the brief; nothing decided.
Implementation started. User picked Option 1 - mask family keeps the canvas and shows the PromptBox; no surface swap.
Derived checklist: implementation + desktop smoke verify.
Option 1 shipped in 13 lines: mask tools keep the canvas and show the PromptBox. 13/13 live-app checks PASS; negative control on HEAD fails exactly the 3 visibility checks.
maturity in-progress -> validating; attention required on the canvas-height trade.
Needs the user in the app: is the shorter canvas while masking an acceptable price?

Round 2: user accepted the space trade, then reported 5 defects. All fixed to root (op-strip rail yank, mask published only on tool exit, sameEntry paint wipe, mode cleared before loadEntry, strip overlap). 21/21 live checks; negative control 12/21 reproduces all five.

USER-VERIFIED LIVE. Mask family keeps the canvas and shows the PromptBox; no surface swap. Five follow-up defects fixed to root, incl. deleting the vestigial radial-era op->prompt-mode force (op strip is the only emitter left).
